# Antigravity Codespaces Pro

> Free, MIT-licensed extension by Nirbhay Hiwse that connects VS Code-based editors (Google Antigravity, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, VSCodium, Kiro) to GitHub Codespaces over SSH through the GitHub CLI. Extension ID: nirbhay-hiwse.antigravity-codespaces. Latest version 5.3.1 (fixes the 5.3.0 bug where a failed connect could still show "Connected") on Open VSX and GitHub releases; the VS Code Marketplace lists 4.3.0.

## Docs
- [Documentation](https://nir-bhay.github.io/antigravity-codespaces/docs.html): install, sign-in scopes, Cloud Hub, SSH config, keepalive, usage analytics, settings and limitations
- [Errors and alerts](https://nir-bhay.github.io/antigravity-codespaces/docs.html#errors): every error message the extension shows, with cause and fix
- [IDE setup guide](https://github.com/Nir-Bhay/antigravity-codespaces/blob/main/docs/IDE_SETUP.md): per-IDE marketplace, CLI and Remote-SSH extension, with sources
- [Agent setup instructions](https://github.com/Nir-Bhay/antigravity-codespaces/blob/main/AGENT_SETUP.md): steps an AI coding agent follows to install and configure the extension

## Guides
- [Why Codespaces is hard outside VS Code](https://nir-bhay.github.io/antigravity-codespaces/guide-why-hard.html): Open VSX gap, Remote-SSH differences, exit codes 255 and 127
- [Codespaces in Google Antigravity](https://nir-bhay.github.io/antigravity-codespaces/guide-antigravity.html): step-by-step SSH setup
- [Codespaces in Cursor](https://nir-bhay.github.io/antigravity-codespaces/guide-cursor.html): step-by-step SSH setup with anysphere.remote-ssh
- [Keeping AI agent sessions alive](https://nir-bhay.github.io/antigravity-codespaces/guide-ai-agents.html): SSH keepalive and codespace idle timeout
- [Quotas explained](https://nir-bhay.github.io/antigravity-codespaces/guide-quota.html): core-hours, GB-month and machine size
- [Codespaces in Windsurf](https://nir-bhay.github.io/antigravity-codespaces/guide-windsurf.html): built-in SSH only, no other Remote-SSH extension
- [Remote-SSH in VS Code forks, compared](https://nir-bhay.github.io/antigravity-codespaces/guide-remote-ssh.html): which SSH extension Cursor, Windsurf, VSCodium, Kiro and Antigravity use
